name: LinkedIn ID verification (CLEAR, Persona)
plain: Checks a government ID and selfie through a partner inside the app.
meaning: Links a real legal identity and face to the profile, then shows a verified badge. Vendor retention rules apply.

android.api_surface: Persona SDK or CLEAR web flow

ios.api_surface: Persona SDK or CLEAR web flow

data.metric: ID images, selfie, chip data, facial geometry

limits.headline: Can check a government ID and a selfie through a partner inside the app
limits.user_action: You tap Verify, take photos of your ID, and scan a selfie
can: Use the camera to photograph your ID and your face
Scan the chip in a passport or ID with NFC (Android and iPhone)
Send the images to a partner like CLEAR or Persona for matching
Show a verified badge on your profile
cannot: Verify you without you taking the photos
See your ID before you scan it
Keep using the camera when you leave the screen
Verify you with no partner check
limits.differs: Both phones use the camera and NFC with a prompt. Android needs the camera permission; iPhone needs a camera purpose string.

story.what_it_is: An app checks your government ID and a selfie through a partner company, then shows a verified badge.
story.for_you: You tap Verify, take a photo of your ID and a selfie, and a partner checks them. If it passes, you get a badge on your profile. Fewer fake profiles contact you.
story.for_makers: Makers want fewer fake accounts and scams, and a badge helps users trust each other. The partner holds the sensitive scans, so retention rules matter. Verified people also bring better ad and hiring value to the platform.

use_cases.example: A professional network adds a badge so recruiters trust a profile is a real person.
A dating app asks for a face check so you know your match is not using someone else's photos.
A ride or rental app confirms a driver's license and face before it gives the person access.
A resale marketplace verifies sellers to cut scams.
A bank opens an account after a live ID and selfie check.
A crypto exchange checks your ID before it lets you buy.

story.android_note: Android apps use the same partner flows, usually through the camera and a web view.
story.ios_note: iPhone apps use the camera and the same partner flows, sometimes with NFC to read a passport chip.

linkedin.how: CLEAR in the US, Canada and Mexico; Persona (NFC passport plus selfie) in other countries; India uses DigiLocker. Persona deletes face geometry after processing and keeps selfie and ID data up to 30 days (third-party write-ups).

history.change: Persona partnership expanded passport verification to more countries (press)
